title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
We're a 60-person B2B SaaS company building a scheduling platform used by 4,000 clinics. You'll join a product team of 8 and own large parts of our customer-facing web app.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional frontend development experience
- Expert-level React (hooks, state management, component architecture)
- Strong TypeScript
- Modern CSS and responsive layouts
- Automated testing of UI code (e.g. Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress)
- Web accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- Web performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals, bundle size, rendering)

Nice to have:
- Next.js or another React meta-framework
- GraphQL
- Building or maintaining a design system / component library
- Mentoring other engineers
- CI/CD pipelines for frontend apps

This is an individual-contributor role at senior level, not a management position.
keySkills: React, TypeScript, CSS, Testing, Accessibility, Performance
stageContext: Series B, product-market fit reached, scaling the product and the team.
whatTheyOwnFirst:
Rebuild the appointment booking flow for performance and accessibility.
Set up visual regression testing for the component library.
